title: Shadows Block Light
objective: Describe how shadows form when light is blocked and how to protect our eyes.

items.prompt: What forms when light is blocked?
items.explanation: When something blocks light, a dark shadow forms behind it. Blocked light does not make a warm spot, a flash, or an echo.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use sound?

options.text: give your ears a rest from loud noise

items.explanation: Resting your ears from loud noise keeps your hearing safe.

items.prompt: Which is the SAFE way to use light?

options.text: name a color in the room
never shine a flashlight into someone's eyes
count the books on a shelf

items.explanation: Bright light in the eyes can hurt them, so never shine a flashlight into someone's eyes.

items.prompt: Which example shows how sound behaves?

options.text: a shadow forms when light is blocked
a whistle makes a high sound

items.explanation: Blowing makes the whistle vibrate, and that makes a high sound. Mirrors, shadows, and windows are about light.

items.prompt: Which example shows how light behaves?

options.text: a shadow forms when light is blocked
a drum makes sound when struck

items.explanation: When something blocks light, a shadow forms — that is light at work. Drums, bells, and claps make sound.
